points: Agents' own write-ups claimed 43% and 71% before Epoch corrected them
One task, one run per model; newer models showed signs of memorising it
take: Asked to rediscover a published training method, Claude Fable 5 reached 2% and GPT-5.6 Sol 15% of the human result. Fully automated AI research is not here.
title: Epoch AI: frontier models cannot yet reinvent a known AI method
